method: Per-source official reference review; archived docs bytes checked locally, pinned engine code range cited in the relic static audit.
scope: Spatial shader properties/render-mode/transparency behavior only. Not new relic shader compile, sorting, raster, performance or AAA approval.

sources.revision_scope: Pinned4.7.2-stable source range; raw source SHA not archived in this ledger.
sources.finding: BaseMaterial3D world-triplanar path regenerates TANGENT/BINORMAL; this material mode does not depend on a stored ordinary UV tangent frame. Ordinary UV normal-map changes need appropriate tangents.

findings: ALPHA writes route material into transparent pipeline; transparency introduces sorting and renderer shadow/screen/depth limitations.
VIEW/COLOR, SPECULAR/ROUGHNESS and EMISSION meanings are relevant to the source shader. Actual visible depth/sorting/occlusion/cost remain camera/runtime gates.
